value for the money who uses cds in the car anymore? i ca not think of the last time i did so when my blaupunkt nevada started to flake i needed to look for something new since the car is aging i could not bring myself to spending the i did on the blau so i looked for something much more modest hoping for streaming bluetooth built in mic this fit the bill and amazon had it for a good price looks it's not flashy which is probably a good thing so it wo not get stolen ease of installation i used wire crimps and it's iso so the wire color match the harness my old blau was iso so i could have just used those plugs but i opted for a clean install sound solid i do not think any stereo can come close to the blaupunkt nevada in terms of pure sound in a stock speaker setup the pyle is not too bad though the w peak is pretty good not as good as the w peak of the nevada but good for the pricepoint the built in eqs are meh i'ld just rather muck with the treble bass settings manually the treble adjustment boosts the high vocal range but not enough of the sparkly highs so tweeters will help the bass boosts too much into the low mids so the sound gets muddy fast if you turn up the bass setting i found that loudness on with bass and treble gave a good sound with barely enough bass punch but not droning or too nasal in the mid highs very good for stereos that only have loudness and bass treble settings bluetooth unless bt is factory installed it'll always be a compromise the mic will never be as good as one with a standalone mic but i did not want to run wiring anywhere for what it is it's clear enough sound coming through the speakers is not bad either no feedback so good vox using the remote control you can actually dial numbers and scroll through call missed received i wish there was a way to do that just on the stereo unit itself also there's no way to prod siri with the remote or on the unit so if you need siri you need your phone out to push the button it also does not auto swap bt with radio etc for driving directions if you're listening to radio and you have directions through bt it'll switch to bt on the unit but not switch back to radio when the directions are done ease of use the instructions are lacking so you need to play with the unit to figure everything out how do you turn on the loudness? the remote has a button but what if that's missing? not in the instructions but experimenting showed that if you hold down the volume knob it'll bring up a secondary menu short press brings up audio controls bass treble fade lr eq loud beep etc is in the secondary menu which you have to dig for a lot of controls on the remote that are not accessible on the unit itself other the usb provides power even when not switched to it good for charging phones display bright although dimmer would be a good addition overall functionality is very good overall despite the lower individual ratings the overall package is a decent considering the functions you get for the price

nice case but you may need a power supply i've used a number of cooler master cases and products over the years and generally have been very pleased with that in mind let me say the case maintains and drop the price a few dollars i bought this to replace a hec low profile htpc case and now i want to order another to move a home server into this is a mini tower but unlike most it allows the user to install full size atx parts the build quality is excellent everything inside is arranged in a logical fashion and it is very easy to work with powered on the top mm fan is almost silent the tool less hd slots are just that and with a tb drive installed i could not detect any real vibration overall this is an excellent case for the price paid where it does fall down is the included w power supply most people who build there own wo not be using it and after putting everything together neither will i the corsair i ordered is on backorder granted the included power supply is nearly silent but it only comes with a pin cpu plug when most boards and processors now want it also lacks a nd rd or th sata power connector i say because it looks like i could install hard drives and a dvd rom in the case as most modern motherboards no longer include ide and most hard drives and cd dvd rom's are sata only this is a problem especially if you want to power both a dvd rom and hard drive at the same time overall this really is the best case for the money it is well built quiet easy to work in and has ample room to fit any number of full size components that you would want to install the down side is that you will want to spend another on a decent power supply i recommend an antec earthwatts or corsair you can get an plus certified w w in that price range which will keep this case nice and quiet if you do not want to order a different power supply do a quick search here on amazon for a molex to sata adapter it will run you about and save you a lot of headache when trying to figure out how to install windows without power to your dvd rom

review unit the problem is that i ca not use it without spending some money for cables as it does not come with cables startech says that's on purpose since people have different cable needs especially different lengths the cables that startech has available for it are over each which comes up to well over for my computers almost the price of the switch with computers connected the price would be even more okay so they do not provide cables but for the price of the switch maybe they should at least give you a coupon or a voucher for one or two cables or a discount on the cables interestingly the port version does include cables the port does not startech's cables are nice as they combine the needed usb with the vga cable otherwise you have to run two completely separate cables one vga cable for monitor and a usb cable for keyboard and mouse if you have usb cables as most people do you can easily purchase the needed vga cables inexpensively this brings me to the first real issue i have with this switch the master monitor connection is a female connector which is standard unfortunately the computer monitor connectors are all male connections so you ca not use a standard male to male vga cable that you would normally use from a computer to a monitor you have to get male to female vga cables which are typically called extension cables why they would use this non standard method of connecting monitors is puzzling a couple of reviewers were also concerned that this switch does not come with a power supply that's usually not a big deal as i found out that a power supply is not necessary as the switch gets it's power from the usb connections there is no explanation as to why it has a place to plug in a power supply although in some cases if you have a lot of usb devices connected to your pc you might need additional power that a power supply would provide so i assume it is for supplemental power it's good that they provide a way to add additional power if you need it even if not the actual power supply the next issue i encountered was trying to determine whether or not you could switch between computers with a hotkey sequence on your keyboard or whether you actually had to reach over to the switch and press the button for the computer you wanted apparently there is no keyboard switching or if there is no one seems to know what keys are used i read the manual for the setup and was concerned that it states that for pc to get the switch to work properly a couple of bios settings for pc need to be changed i am not even sure that my computers have those particular settings especially my older computers that sometimes have more limited bios settings available i have had other kvm switches and none of them needed a change to bios settings given the problems that others have had with this switch in that it does not always work flawlessly i am not sure that i want to take time to test it right since i already have a nicely working kvm switch i still have to buy cables on the plus side this switch appears to be well built with a metal case not cheap plastic it appears to be nice and solid and just heavy enough if the issues i mentioned are not a deal breaker for you i think this is worth trying i will update my review and add or subtract stars once i have a chance to test this in actual operation

installation tips thin scrath proofing that maintains style fit but difficult to apply the dilemma with any iphone protector is making it work for the variety of circumstances you want to use the phone for holsters while keeping your phone readily accessible do not prevent scratches when you take the iphone out rubber cases while providing protection tend to prevent the iphone from fitting in a dock invisible shield on the other hand is thin enough to not interfere with docking while providing good scratch protection it's clear so your iphone's style is not hidden and you can use invisible shield with say a holster at the same time! it's a great solution for those who want to protect their iphone from scratches but still allow the phone to fit into accessories designed for its original size there are a few drawbacks however first while providing good scratch protection invisible shield does not provide good impact protection second while invisible shield covers the iphone better than any other clear protector i've used it does not cover of the phone's surface are more like third invisible shield's installation is fairly difficult to get right at least not without ripples forming on the corners if you deside to purchase this protector however i have a few installation tips listed below installation tips as the instructions say spray your fingers with the included spray before working with the film to prevent fingerprints note that there are two thin strips of film on the top and bottom of the front film sheet apply these after you apply the rest of the back film when working with the rounded edges on the back of the iphone keep in mind that you want to have the film taught in the correct direction to avoid ripples from popping up you can pull the edges taught by either peeling a still wet edge back and gently pulling it the right direction when reapplying it or by firmly rubbing the edge corner outward with your thumb film that is not taught will result in a ripple around on a nearby edge while film that is taught in the wrong direction may result in a ripple in a nearby nook or corner work quickly with the film edges and corners until no ripples immediately pop up after you press them all down even after doing your best with pulling edges and corners taught you're still going to have little ripples that want to pop up along the corners of the iphone it might take a minute for them to manifest themselves but they will come therefore here's the best tip i can give use saran wrap to hold the top and bottom edge of the film down while it dries when you have your installation mostly smooth no bubbles and no ripples that do not stay pressed down for more than a few seconds then tear off two small pieces of saran wrap and tightly stretch one piece across the top edge of the iphone and one along the bottom if the saran wrap is stretched correctly it will hold the errant ripples down along the rounded corners while the adhesive drys permanently try to leave the saran wrap on for hours if possible as it takes time to dry following the above tips i managed to install my invisible shield such that i ca not even tell it's on! there are no visible bubbles or ripples anywhere! i wish the same for you if you buy invisible shield as it's a bit of a delicate operation good luck!

sales reductions and such over the ear and stylish hopefully these looked like the perfect headphones and i even got them for dollars which was great however when i got them there were a number of brand new that i figured they could only get worse with time i tried charging the headphones to see if that made a difference in the skipping but it did pretty much nothing i did not try it with them plugged in because if those were the only conditions that they would work then i would send them back anyway seeing as wireless was one of my main criteria another problem was that the power button was really hard to press down on while it was still on your head it was a thin button and you had to hold it down for seconds to turn on and then a couple more seconds for bluetooth to activate if you forgot to wait for bluetooth to be activated you'd have to turn it off and try again because after you released the power button it would function as an off button they advertise a carbon fiber thought that even if they were not a snug fit that the volume from my hair would bulk up my head a bit it did not the earcups fit over my ears but after an hour of them on the top part of my ear wanted to configure the administrative settings without having to mess with the disks? ca not do it so i put a random hard drive in and fired it up without asking me it automatically started formatting the disk not very nice i'd prefer to initiate that stuff myself luckily the hard drive did not contain any useful data as it was just for testing purposes which leads to point two if you replace the disks the unit automatically does a factory reset without even warning you i found this out the hard way after setting up numerous users and shares and fully customizing the settings just to have it all wiped away when i replaced the disk with a larger one there is a way to backup the configuration but i really should not have to worry about that replacing the disks should not incur an not possible the encryption system itself is not documented as to what kind of encryption is used and its strength if you want to create an encrypted raid volume you must insert a usb flash drive or accessing the encrypted volume one positive thing is that when i removed the usb key after boot the share did not stop working so i guess that is a workaround albeit not an ideal one overall the have inserted x tb wd red nas rpm disks and the unit auto configured itself as a raid so i have about tb of total storage the rebuild took about hours to complete i enabled encryption on the volume over a day the average upload write speed was about mbits sec when i download files from the nas the read speeds are a little better about mbits sec far below the mbit connection between these two machines and the mbyte sec speeds that these drives have been benchmarked on various hardware sites i was hoping to get at least a good mbits sec transfer speeds over smb but that seems above this unit's capabilities not to mention when i was doing the upload of all my data to the nas the web based interface slowed to a crawl to almost unusable furthermore the web based interface does not show the current cpu load or history it just shows the cpu temperature and that is it i would give this nas stars if it were not for the terrible transfer speeds and performance under load i do not know if it's because i have encryption enabled on a raid volume but i would think that most modern nas boxes could handle this kind of setup without undergoing significant processor strain as i'm only getting about out of the gigabit network connection that this box has for the price i paid i ca not really complain maybe i'm expecting commercial level speeds out of a consumer level box but when hard drives a big step backwards i own four logitech harmony one remote controls and love them what makes the harmony one such a great remote is its combination of hard keys and touchscreen keys frequently used keys were available as physical buttons your fingers can find them and push them without having to take your eyes off of the tv less frequently used buttons can be moved to a touch screen all of the related hard keys were located within easy reach of one another the touchscreen was not within easy reach but that did not matter because you had to take your eyes off of the tv screen to see and push them anyway unfortunately logitech took all the great design features of the harmony one and eliminated them when creating this remote this remote is a huge step backwards here's why bad software with the harmony one logitech used software that you downloaded from their web site and ran on your computer it was very well designed and easy to use now they use a web based application that relies on microsoft silverlight it is quite buggy and slow inconvenient keys the transport keys are located above the touch screen while all the other keys are located below the touch screen this is very inconvenient because it means that you have to look down at the remote and physically move it in your hand in order to reach the fast foward rewind pause stop and record buttons and then move it back when you want to use the up down left right guide pvr info and ok buttons on the harmony one the transport keys were just below the navigation keys having related keys near one another makes the remote much more convenient to use separating them makes the remote far more difficult to use missing keys the skip forward and skip backward buttons are gone completely gone you can remap the fast forward and rewind keys but then you have to use the touchscreen for those or remap the colored keys which are located as far away from the transport keys as they could possibly be no motion sensor older harmony remotes had a motion sensor and would activate the touch screen when you picked up the remote you could turn the feature off if you did not want it this remote does not have the feature at all more missing keys the help and activities button have been replaced with touch sensitive keys that have icons the activities button now looks like a home icon just to make things more confusing the word home also appears on the screen when you are on the home screen but pressing on the word home does nothing the help button is now a question mark icon that's way too easy to push by accident swipe now required previously you'd see activity choices on the touch screen at a time now you only see one to get to the others you have to swipe to the left or the right i'm fine with swiping to get to more choices but there's no reason why they made only one option per screen bigger screen fewer options the screen is larger but you have fewer options on each screen you can no longer get to the devices from within an activity now if you want to change a setting on a device that is not included in the activity you have to go back to the home screen also logitech changed the size of soft buttons from a finger sized square to a longer thinner rectangle making it even easier to hit the wrong button poorly designed charger the charging plug for this unit comes with a british ac adaptor and then a u s converter as a result it sticks out of the wall by about inches dumb! battery not removable prior harmony remotes had removeable batteries so if the battery died you could replace it this one is permanently installed you have to break it open to remove it only at the end of the product's life so i pay more and get less! thanks logitech! this remote is a redesign that sacrifices function for form it is a huge step backwards with no corresponding benefits in my view the best remotes do not use a touch screen at all having a screen that is accompanied by hard buttons is best the screen allows the hard buttons to have different labels and a more button to scroll i used to recommend the harmony one even though it had a touch screen because setup was so easy and there were enough hard buttons that the touch screen only needed to be used infrequently today i recommend either asin b fl e k urc mastercontrol rf universal learning remote with rf capability or the asin b ukrrd urc r my favorite remote advanced universal remote control for up to a v components both are even better than the harmony one because they have all hard physical buttons the buttons at the top are adjacent to a screen which allows those buttons to be used for more than one function the transport buttons are conveniently located near the navigation buttons the only downside of these remotes is that they are programmed by hand and not using a computer they're preprogrammed with many common remotes and can learn directly from an existing remote but the process is a bit more complicated than the logitech software and more time consuming

great for movie night okay i'm not one of those who streams a lot of movies because our internet service is a little erratic in the mountains we get way too much lag if we're trying to use more than a few devices computers at the same time on our wireless network so essentially we have to power down everything else if we want to stream a movie but given the opportunity to review this projector and especially if i download a movie to my computer instead of trying to stream it i have to say that it's a really nice experience for a movie night with dh even without a projector screen projecting onto a buff colored textured wall the image is not bad at all you do need a darkened room for the best viewing experience of course and i'm sure the image would be a whole heck of a lot better with an appropriate screen our roku box works just fine in either of the two hdmi slots it takes some fiddling to get the settings just right but you can start out with everything set to auto and then go from there the manual horizontal vertical adjuster on the projector itself does not work however if you set the h v extended settings to auto do not attempt to do anything until you've checked the product manual for proper positioning and adjustments projectors like this while in some ways easy to use are not completely plug and play your environment positioning of furniture lighting and distance of the projector from the wall screen all will have an impact on the quality of the viewing image movie houses take down all the lights and have curtained walls for a reason our living room is fairly cozy small we have a wide recessed area in the wall across from our seating area where we have our daytime while working tv set up for background watching news or listening to digital music and this room is where i work on my laptop during the day i was able to get the image from the projector to almost fill this wall width and float above the top of the smaller tv so we do not have to move anything when we want to watch a movie on the weekend of course the image can go considerably larger up to a barely imaginable ! but in our case that would take it out of the recessed area if you do not have a suitable home theater style or outdoor setup going larger can be like sitting in the first few rows of a movie theater headache inducing i found the projector to be a little noisy unless set on the energy saving setting also i discovered that closing the lens shutter in the front turns off the projector resulting in the need to re download a streamed movie the remote that comes with the projector provides access to most settings you would need while watching various media without having to go into the menu settings on the projector itself you can also hook up a sound system to it which i would want to do if setting up a dedicated theater space ideally you'll want to have your power access nearby installed in the floor or the projector cabinet and that's not something we're going to do so now we've got the projector sitting on the coffee table in the middle of the room with the cords running to a surge suppressor lying beside the sofa that's not a setup that would work for us unless we're actually sitting down watching a movie if you're going to dive in and do the dedicated home theater thing be prepared to spend some money to do it right

these are a great early version of tiny bluetooth ear buds i decided to write a review for these because of the high number of negative reviews and i felt that to be unfair so here it goes these earned a stars because sometimes they just do not talk to my iphone when they've already been paired with it cycling power on them or turning on off bluetooth on my phone usually fixes it but that's not unique to these products this technology is only a few years old and these micro sized bluetooth versions of ear buds are even newer so naturally you might see issues with them from time to time but for the most part they're really well performing pros they're tiny and you do not have annoying cables hanging down anymore they charge quickly and have a nice portable charge pack that you can use to charge other things like your cell phone interesting magnetics hold the buds in place while they charge and they glow a nice red until they're charged they come with three sizes of rubber ear bud thingies and are sized a bit large i had to use the small ones perfect for gym activities because they do not get in the way at all and i do not have problems with them falling out while running or cycling sound quality is good given their size and do not leave me wishing for better sound they charge quickly and after an hour of use they're charged again in minutes cons not all bluetooth devices work well together and these sometimes have issues with some of my devices sometimes they do not connect to devices they just connected to cycling power or turning off on bluetooth usually fixes that they're easy to lose but i love the size anyhow you can probably track them down by general vicinity until their power runs out by checking your bluetooth list on your devices summary i boy were we dumb about gps units i am one of the most geographically challenged people on this planet so when i got a chance to review this magellan roadmate unit i jumped on it i've never owned a gps but have always wanted one dh and i mistakenly thought however that we had to have a monthly service agreement to use one how pleasantly surprised we were to discover that we just plug it in tell it where we want to go and go! we also are happy with how big and readable the screen is being older folks we need that bigger screen with the av in capability for watching videos or dvds on the roadmate the screen is a definite boon should we find ourselves on a long trip we are using this gps unit in a toyota tacoma so without having someone defeat the cigarette lighter's automatic shut off the unit powers down when the ignition is turned off actually i think i prefer that to having it on all the time and having to remember to turn it off we do not have cell phone service but if we wind up getting it so we can use the 's awesome capability to function as a hands free phone via bluetooth we'll probably want to have someone who knows what they are doing help us hook it up to a constant power source and trickle charger we wound up buying an asin b df e e autodashmount portable friction mount with degree fully articulating neck for optimum view and dashboard fit removable to use with this instead of the window mount that came with the product because we can just sit it in the floorboard of our truck when we get out locking of course so it does not call attention to itself but the included window mount is heavy duty and works very well you just ca not remove it easily although you can pop the gps unit off of it fairly quickly and throw it into the glove compartment the mount hanging there on the window however is a dead giveaway that you have something pricey in the car that someone might want to steal i like the pois points of interest and aaa ratings programmed into the device a lot especially the restaurants educational institutions service stations healthcare emergency facilities and grocery stores we just moved to a small mountainous community in north georgia and this unit is definitely helping us find our way around when we're kicking around nearby towns we've noticed that a lot of little hole in the wall restaurants we did not know about are in our device mdash restaurants we would not have found on our own mdash but a handful of them are no longer in business this is not surprising though because those restaurants have only very recently closed their doors for what we have needed the roads have been pretty much accurate you just have to be sure the unit has a clear view of the sky there's no telling what you'll get if you hold it flat in your lap it can lose its mind being able to see the map view with side roads definitely encourages exploration that we would not otherwise have done we keep the autozoom turn feature turned on and we've found that even if a road name is wrong probably because there are three or four different names for some roads in georgia the chime telling us to turn is always accurate although we have not had occasion to use it where we are we're looking forward to having the lifetime traffic feature and lane guidance when we go on treks to larger cities near us such as chattanooga or atlanta to visit family and shop i like it that you can ignore turn advice and it seems to adjust quickly to give you a different route based on where you are perhaps my favorite thing about this gps is that you can program multiple destinations into your trip then if desired have it calculate the most efficient way to make all the stops you can also cancel one or more stops if you get too tired this could save a lot of money on gas by ganging trips and taking the best routes to get 'er done dh is the type who wants to go one place then go right back home mdash a man in other words mdash so i'm hoping this multi destination feature will help us reach more fuel efficient compromises had i been purchasing my first gps and not receiving the product gratis in return for reviewing it the magellan roadmate would have been a pricey feature laden bit of overkill given that we do not have cell phone service and do not take long trips with kids who need to be entertained with dvds but i have to say that i am just delighted with this unit's wonderful features i think dh and i are far more likely now to get out and about than we were before and that's a good thing for a retired couple

amazon but decided to purchase tech armor due to using the product before and the fact it there was no need to use any liquids and suction cups i have to say i never had an easier time apply a screen protector i did not watch the video i did follow the instructions the package contains several pieces of tape to collect stray dust hair etc so there is almost no possibility of trapping any dust if you clean the screen thoroughly with either the provided wipe or your personal preference for cleaning the screen and then use the tape strips i kept the strip readily as i noticed when i moved or started another step there was dust again on the screen so keep using the tape right until you apply the protector the auctions cups are genius i do not have steady nor dainty hands for a female i did find the suction cups a little small but i was able to use them success the suction cups allowed me to easily align the screen and as i slowly lowered the protector to the screen it was as if the protector was attracted to the screen it adhered super easy and i was able to attain almost perfect alignment upon removal of the suction cups i had two air bubbles however i was able to resolve this state that this is a one use protector so it is important you follow the directions and take your time it only took me minutes to successfully install the protector and my ipad pro was ready to use you cannot remove and reset the protector once you press it on so be sure to place it lightly first to ensure you have it placed correctly before pressing it down on the screen to make it stick if you all of our sound equipment during november after a power surge the new receiver is an onkyo tx sr which is flexible and more than enough switching power to handle home theater gaming and auxiliary sound from a squeezebox receiver asin b vei ko onkyo tx sr channel a v surround home theater receiver black a most intriguing feature on the receiver is the universal port which provides power and connectivity to certain outboard accessories the idea is to integrate extensions that onkyo would otherwise have to build into the receiver among those extensions is an extended tuner to allow hd radio reception asin b rhrfq onkyo up ht hd radio tuner another is this dock the amazon com description promises compatibility with onkyo's range of receivers and explicitly mentions the tx sr the good it takes less than five minutes to thread the cable into a media cabinet pull the receiver forward and plug in to the universal port the port input on the receiver is preset for input from devices on the universal port both an ipod nano g and an iphone g fit easily into the dock rather than bothering with a set of plastic inserts keyed to the various ipod configurations onkyo places the port connector in the center of the dock and uses a thumbwheel to hold the device in place this is a clever and much less fiddly arrangement audio plays well and sounds terrific video plays through on our i flatscreen connected via hdmi the video appeared to be up sampled appropriately though it did show the kinds of artifacts one would expect from a source originally formatted for ipod the bad there is no on screen display osd the amazon com description correctly notes that up a is only compatible with a v receivers tx sr and higher and home theater systems ht s and a statement picked up from onkyo's web site but fails to note that onkyo also includes this footnote note extended mode is available only on compatible a v receivers tx sr and lower models feature only standard mode no osd from ipod available the lack of osd means that in effect one has to walk up to one's ipod with the onkyo remote in hand in order to have any control over what is playing on the ipod this negates most of the benefits of an integrated dock! one could argue that gee onkyo's site states this fact plainly but of course we rely on product descriptions from amazon as well as reviews to make purchasing decisions it is also worth noting that the product packaging and documentation make no mention of compatibility or features amazon has graciously agreed to accept a return on this product only the something very different than what i got

aduro aquasound wsp waterproof shower i received this speaker in exchange for an honest review and an honest review is what you get no hyperbole at all in truth i hear no difference between this speaker and another aquasound speaker i reviewed quite some time ago this speaker paired up easily and quickly to my ipod and was just as easy to use of benefit is that when shutting the speaker off it also stops your device from playing so as not to drain your device's battery charge it had no problems with the suction cup sticking to the side of my bath tub but you should not try to attach the suction cup to any grained not totally smooth surface as not enough suction will be available due to air seeping in my only complaint with this blue tooth speaker is that the suction cup back piece slides easily into the speaker and then you attach it to the tile you do need to be careful about holding the speaker by this back piece as the speaker itself can slid out of the suction cup's holder and be dropped i would have preferred the suction cup be permanently a part of the speaker other than that the speaker has plenty of power reproduces bass as well as a small low powered speaker can expect to be in other words there is not much bass that this can reproduce in the shower you would not hear much along those lines also i would not recommend that you bring it up to its highest volume as noticeable distortion can be heard step the volume down a notch and you should be fine i do hope that this brief review has been of some help to you in deciding upon your purchase thank you for reading
